# `14-hedging` — Routing and Hedging

| | |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | T1 |

## Purpose

Decides what to hedge, where, and when — from exposure, liquidity, LP health and risk policy — and never lies to itself about whether a hedge worked.

## Depends on

- [`12-risk-book`](12-risk-book.md) — Internal Risk Book
- [`13-lp-connectivity`](13-lp-connectivity.md) — LP / FIX Connectivity

## Depended on by

_nothing depends on this module yet._

## Inputs

- exposure
- LP liquidity
- LP health
- hedge policy

## Outputs

- hedge decisions
- hedge orders
- hedge fills

## What gets built

- A-book / B-book / hybrid routing policy as versioned data
- hedge sizing and throttling
- LP selection by health, latency and cost
- hedge failure handling and escalation

## Invariants

These are executed as tests at gate **G4**. A module may not declare an
invariant it does not test.

- INV-130: a failed hedge is never recorded as a successful hedge.
- INV-131: hedge state is always one of pending, filled, partially-filled, failed — never unknown-and-ignored.
- INV-132: routing decisions are deterministic given inputs and policy version.

## Test obligations

- LP unavailable, stale, rejecting, partially filling, latency-spiking
- market gap during an in-flight hedge
- policy version change mid-flight

## Known failure modes

The things that go wrong in systems like this one. Each should map to a test above.

_none declared_
